content: Integrate, extend, and automate {{organizationName}} {{editorsName}} and {{productName}} using developer tools — from Docs Connect and Embed SDK to webhooks and OAuth apps. Choose a tool below to get started.

comment.text: Descriptive paragraph in the Developer Tools page header that introduces integration and automation options. It includes variables for the organization name, the editors' name, and the product name.

usage.context:
<div className={styles.header}>
 <Text fontSize="23px" fontWeight={700} lineHeight="28px">
 {t("Common:DeveloperTools")}
 </Text>
 <Text fontSize="13px" fontWeight={400} lineHeight="20px">
 {t("Settings:DeveloperToolsDescription", {
 organizationName: getBrandName("OrganizationName"),
 editorsName: getBrandName("ProductEditorsName"),
 productName: getBrandName("ProductName"),
 })}
 </Text>
